title: Deny the Pass One Pass Away
description: A defender practises denying the easy pass to a teammate one pass away, staying in the passing lane with an active hand ready to deflect.

content.objective: Stay in the passing lane to deny the ball while still seeing both ball and player.
content.setup: A ball handler at the top looks to pass to a teammate one pass away on the wing.
instructions: The defender angles the chair with a hand in the passing lane, seeing both ball and player.
The ball handler looks to find a passing window at different angles.
The defender adjusts chair position with every ball movement, staying in the lane.
Rotate: a completed pass means the denial defender switches roles.
coachingPoints: Keep a hand in the passing lane at all times.
See the ball and the player at the same time — never fully turn away from either.
Adjust the chair angle on the pass, not after it.
commonMistakes: Turning away from the ball to watch only the offensive player.
Staying in one fixed position instead of adjusting with ball movement.
Rotating to the wrong player and leaving someone else open.
content.safety: Hands stay in the passing lane only, no reaching into the offensive player's lap.
